name: Bahrain
summary: Bahrain, Day 241. Host of the Fifth Fleet and, on 18 Oct, of the Russia–GCC Strategic Dialogue, where GCC ministers urged Moscow to restrain Iran and invoked collective defence while rejecting Iran's Hormuz permit-and-fee regime. No kinetic event on Bahraini soil in the window.

recent_signals.headline: Hosted the 22nd IISS Manama Dialogue (30–31 Oct): the Crown Prince stressed freedom of navigation in Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb; GCC SG Al Budaiwi: 'diplomacy needs partners, partners who respond in kind… The GCC states were not a party to the war'; UK minister Doughty listed air-defence support in Bahrain, Saudi Arabia and Kuwait. No kinetic incident on Bahraini territory. (CONFIRMED; intel DIP-B3, SAU-B3)

Bahrain hosted the 9th Russia–GCC Strategic Dialogue (Manama, 18 Oct): GCC ministers urged Moscow to press Iran to stop attacks; Lavrov pitched GCC-plus-Iran 'collective security'; GCC invoked collective defence the same day and rejected Iran's Hormuz 'prior authorization… transit fees' regime. No Bahrain-specific kinetic event. (CONFIRMED; intel DIP-A10, SAU-A13, KIN-A3)

**No strike on Bahraini territory in the window; Bahrain called on the UNSC/ICAO to act on the Riyadh airport attack (Res. 2216/2817).** WaPo (via New Arab, 11 Oct): earlier Iranian strikes severely damaged the 5th Fleet HQ — single-source; Pentagon reportedly weighing Gulf-base drawdowns. — REPORTED.

**At the Germany chiefs' meeting (Axios); its refusal to attend the Iran–Gulf Salalah meeting stands — the hardest Gulf position on record; Oman has set no new date.** Pentagon IG confirmed Iran struck the Navy logistics hub in Bahrain with drones and ballistic missiles (Feb–Jun period). — CONFIRMED (IG) / REPORTED (meeting).

Bahrain REFUSED to attend the 14-Sep Salalah Iran–Gulf Hormuz meeting, citing security concerns — the hardest Gulf position on record against an Iranian-run lane, and a proximate cause of Oman's postponement. Iran claimed strikes on Bahrain-area US assets in the 1-Sep salvo (CLAIMED). (AP/CBS — CONFIRMED refusal)

Hit in Iran's SECOND wave -- ballistic missiles at the Sheikh Isa airbase; an 11-year-old girl injured and property damage in Hamad City/Manama from intercepted-drone shrapnel. Response stayed in the established pattern: absorb, intercept, condemn, mediate -- no expulsion, no downgrade. Saudi Arabia and Qatar signaled 'diplomacy still possible' after the wave.

**FIFTH FLEET HQ STRUCK AGAIN — IRGC DRONES/MISSILES INTERCEPTED, ZERO DAMAGE PER US OFFICIAL, HIT-CLAIM DENIED; GULF MARKETS CALM (TADAWUL +0.4%).** On June 10 the IRGC launched drones/missiles at the US Fifth Fleet HQ in Bahrain (alongside Ali Al Salem/Kuwait and, for the first time, Azraq/Jordan). The IRGC CLAIMED 21 targets and 4 destroyed (incl an F-35 hangar + a downed MQ-9); AGAINST that, a US official said NO injuries to US personnel and NO damage to US facilities, and the US 'intercepted nearly all' missiles and drones. THIRD iteration of the established pattern (June 5-6 barrage; the CENTCOM-denied Fifth Fleet claim; now this) — spectacular claims, intercepted reality, zero casualties = performative deterrence; the genuinely new element is Jordan (first non-Gulf Arab ally struck), not Bahrain. The Arab League (Aboul Gheit) condemned the 'brutal' attacks and accused Iran of 'seeking to escalate confrontation with Arab states' — but NO expulsions, NO downgrades, NO Article-51 invocations. Gulf equity stayed calm (Saudi Tadawul +0.4%). Latent risk: Bahrain's ALBA aluminium smelter (Lines 1-3) remains offline since mid-March; aluminium hit a 4-year high June 2 then unwound -9.4% on the Israel-Iran stand-down — ALBA non-restart is a latent re-pricing risk.

recent_signals.headline: **BAHRAIN TO BE REBUILT WITH IRANIAN MONEY; UAE JOINS THE GCC CONDEMNATION.** Treasury's 6-June move to fund Gulf-ally reconstruction from frozen Iranian assets covers Bahrain (which intercepted the 5-6 June barrage and sounded air-raid sirens), giving it a material stake in Washington's refusal to return the $24bn to Tehran (CONFIRMED policy action; intel B1). The GCC condemnation widened — the UAE denounced the targeting of Kuwait and Bahrain 'in the strongest terms' (intel A3). No fresh Bahrain hit over the weekend; the 6-Jun evening event was drones near Hormuz, zero casualties.

**BAHRAIN TARGETED AGAIN AND ACTIVATED AIR-RAID SIRENS — 7-MISSILE SALVO AT KUWAIT/BAHRAIN (5-6 JUNE), 6 INTERCEPTED, 7TH MISSED, ZERO CASUALTIES; IRGC FIFTH-FLEET-HQ HIT CLAIM CENTCOM-DENIED AGAIN.** Overnight 5-6 June Iran fired 7 ballistic missiles at Kuwait and Bahrain (plus 4 drones toward Hormuz); US forces intercepted 6 of 7 missiles, the 7th missed, ZERO casualties, and struck Iranian coastal radar at Goruk + Qeshm Island in self-defence. Bahrain activated air-raid sirens. The IRGC claimed it struck the US Fifth Fleet HQ in Manama; CENTCOM rejected the claim as FALSE (all Iranian attacks on US forces failed, no US assets harmed). CBS confirms this exchange is SEPARATE from and SMALLER than the 3-June Kuwait-airport attack (11 projectiles vs ~30, zero deaths vs one) — Iran reverted to the calibrated/zero-casualty playbook.

recent_signals.headline: **BAHRAIN DIRECTLY TARGETED IN THE 3 JUNE BARRAGE — BDF INTERCEPTED 3 IRANIAN MISSILES AND A NUMBER OF DRONES AIMED AT 'CIVILIAN SITES,' NO CASUALTIES; IRGC FALSELY CLAIMED A FIFTH FLEET HQ HIT.** Bahrain's Defence Force General Command said it intercepted three Iranian missiles and several drones aimed at civilian sites, no casualties. The IRGC claimed it struck the US Fifth Fleet HQ in Manama; CENTCOM rejected the claim as FALSE (all attacks on US forces failed, no US assets harmed). Bahrain (Fifth Fleet host) was a direct interception party in the cycle's first casualty-producing barrage but absorbed the strikes cleanly — the lethal damage landed on Kuwait's civilian airport.

recent_signals.headline: BAHRAIN MOI ANNOUNCED MAY 9 IT HAD ARRESTED 41 ALLEGED IRGC-LINKED INDIVIDUALS — FIRST MAJOR GULF-STATE INTERNAL ACTION AGAINST ALLEGED IRGC NETWORK DURING THE CYCLE. Suspects had 'direct contact' with IRGC and had collected funds intended to be sent to Iran; investigations continue, further action anticipated. Rights groups argue Bahrain may be using war as cover to crack down on dissent generally (Bahrain hosts US Fifth Fleet, historical Sunni-government / Shia-majority tensions). Two readings: (a) substantive intelligence breakthrough; (b) opportunistic crackdown. Either way, Bahrain is publicly aligning with US blockade narrative against Iran. Gulf-state response to Iran now openly bifurcated: Bahrain (pro-US, anti-IRGC), Saudi (deniable-pro-US, public-pro-mediation), UAE (hawkish), Qatar (mediating with IRGC contacts), Oman (silent), Kuwait (denied airspace).
recent_signals.verification: CONFIRMED ACTION — 41 arrests, public Bahrain MoI statement (Khaleej Times primary, Washington Post + PBS + AP wire pickup multi-source); Iran has NOT commented publicly; rights-group alternative framing = REPORTED (HRW, others)

PART OF THE CALIBRATED GULF-WIDE RETALIATION (zero US casualties); GCC RESPONSE: DEAL MUST ADDRESS IRAN'S MISSILES/DRONES/PROXIES
BAHRAIN: SHEIKH ISA AB STRUCK AGAIN (drones); IRAN CLAIMED STRIKES ON US FORCES IN BAHRAIN 16-17 JUL; NO CONFIRMED US CASUALTIES; BAHRAIN CONTINUES INTERCEPTION-AND-CONDEMNATION POSTURE

Iran claimed strikes on Sakhir airbase (targeting US helicopters and reconnaissance aircraft) and Sheikh Isa Air Base over 17-19 Jul; air-raid sirens sounded repeatedly. No casualties reported and NO HOST CONFIRMATION OF DAMAGE — Bahrain took defensive action and intercepted multiple Iranian aerial attacks. Tag CLAIMED on the damage. Bahrain remains a target without becoming a co-belligerent. CLAIMED.

**Bahrain's Foreign Ministry condemned Iranian drone strikes on the country's AIR TRAFFIC SYSTEMS**, saying they endanger civilian travel; the civil aviation body said air navigation equipment was targeted but **flights were unaffected**; air raid sirens sounded. The IRGC claimed a radar and air-defence system at Muharraq and a **Patriot battery at Riffa**, and on 21 July additionally claimed it **targeted Amazon infrastructure in Bahrain** — **CLAIMED, no Bahraini or Amazon confirmation, and precisely the profile of a claim made for domestic consumption.** The **US Embassy in Bahrain warned** that Iran may seek to target unspecified locations in **central Manama**, urging Americans to shelter on sirens or explosions — a threat warning, not an event. Per diplomats, **Bahrain is now the most hardline Arab state against Iran** and is the one pushing the US/Gulf UNSC draft on Hormuz. CONFIRMED (host condemnation) / CLAIMED (IRGC damage).
